blocked: The stock app has no session-login descriptor: its sign-in is the host form (login/submit) or a bearer token (api/auth/login), and SiteCli can only keep a composed session cookie. Needs a SiteCli bearer or a stock session-login route before this runs.
title: Signed-in user opens and merges a pull request on the emulated GitHub; anonymous and merged-PR writes are refused

contrib.instructions: You are contrib, a signed-in host account. Open a pull request from feature/scenario into master on SeppoPakonen/demo-repo, then merge it. Say each milestone on AgentIPC with @scenario-oversight.

anon.instructions: You are not signed in. Try to merge pull request 1 and expect a refusal. Say the refusal on AgentIPC with @scenario-oversight.

steps.describe: an anonymous session cannot merge a pull request (role negative)
the open pull requests are listed
the contributor opens a pull request from a feature branch
the contributor merges the pull request it opened
merging an already merged pull request is refused
